Warns when frontend edits drift toward generic template-looking UI. Keeps visual output distinctive and intentional.
EVENT: POSTTOOLUSE
Runs after a tool completes. Can validate output or trigger follow-up actions.
WHEN IT FIRES
After Edit / Write on frontend files
HOW TO USE
1
Attach this hook to agents in the Advanced → Skills & Hooks panel before running a pipeline.
2
The hook's behaviour will be injected as a guideline into the agent's execution context.
